options.name: attach
options.description: A list of pathnames of files to attach to the message. Attached files have their content-type set to C(application/octet-stream).

options.name: bcc
options.description: The email-address(es) the mail is being 'blind' copied to. This is a list, which may contain address and phrase portions.

options.name: body
options.description: The body of the email being sent.

options.name: cc
options.description: The email-address(es) the mail is being copied to. This is a list, which may contain address and phrase portions.

options.name: charset
options.description: The character set of email being sent.

options.name: ehlohost
options.description: Allows for manual specification of host for EHLO.

options.name: headers
options.description: A list of headers which should be added to the message. Each individual header is specified as V(header=value) (see example below).

options.name: message_id_domain
options.description: The domain name to use for the L(Message-ID header, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Message-ID).

options.name: port
options.description: The mail server port. This must be a valid integer between V(1) and V(65534).

options.name: secure
options.description: If V(always), the connection only sends email if the connection is Encrypted. If the server does not accept the encrypted connection it fails. If V(try), the connection attempts to setup a secure SSL/TLS session, before trying to send. If V(never), the connection does not attempt to setup a secure SSL/TLS session, before sending. If V(starttls), the connection tries to upgrade to a secure SSL/TLS connection, before sending. If it is unable to do so it fails.

options.name: sender
options.description: The email-address the mail is sent from. May contain address and phrase.

options.name: subject
options.description: The subject of the email being sent.

options.name: subtype
options.description: The minor mime type, can be either V(plain) or V(html). The major type is always V(text).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Sets the timeout in seconds for connection attempts.

options.name: to
options.description: The email-address(es) the mail is being sent to. This is a list, which may contain address and phrase portions.
